title: VOO Lounge
venue_description:
About VOO Lounge

VOO Lounge represents a stunning revival of Kansas Citys historic Rendezvous space bringing sophisticated jazz entertainment back to the heart of downtown. Located in the Kansas City Marriott Downtown at 1214 Baltimore Avenue this intimate cocktail lounge features elegant art-deco decor plush seating and an atmosphere reminiscent of the golden age of jazz.

Historic Jazz Legacy

The venue occupies a space steeped in Kansas City music history. This is the same building where the Coon-Sanders Original Nighthawk Orchestra made jazz history with late-night national radio broadcasts in the early days of American jazz. VOO Lounge proudly continues this legacy by hosting live jazz performances and open mic sessions that honor Kansas Citys pivotal role in jazz development.

Open Mic Jazz Jam

Every Wednesday from 7-11 PM VOO Lounge hosts a legendary open mic jazz jam led by Dr. Mike Pagan and his trio. Dr. Pagan brings impressive credentials with a Doctor of Music from Northwestern University and performs alongside some of Kansas Citys finest jazz talent. The weekly jam welcomes instrumentalists vocalists and jazz enthusiasts of all skill levels. Whether youre a seasoned player a curious newcomer or simply a jazz lover the vibe is electric and the setting is iconic. Theres no cover charge and free downtown parking is available making it accessible for all.

Regular Programming

In addition to Wednesday night jams VOO Lounge features rotating musicians and performers every Friday and Saturday night from 6 PM to 1 AM. The venue hosts special events including cocktail-making classes private parties corporate events and wedding celebrations. The space can accommodate up to 100 guests for private events.

Atmosphere and Amenities

The lounge features a visually stunning interior with elegant speakeasy-style decor dim lighting and intimate seating arrangements including bar seating high-top tables and plush couches. The fully stocked bar offers meticulously crafted cocktails an impressive wine selection and classic drinks. Wednesday night specials include 25% off entire tabs for musicians and service industry professionals happy hour pricing on premium wells and draft beer and discounts on whiskey and wine pours. Featured cocktails from Restless Spirits Distilling add local flavor to the drink menu.

Parking and Accessibility

Complimentary 2-hour self-parking is available in the Kansas City Marriott Downtown Garage. Valet parking is also offered for $15. The venue is wheelchair accessible though some areas require elevator use.

Hours of Operation

VOO Lounge is open Wednesday and Thursday from 4-10 PM and Friday and Saturday from 6 PM to 1 AM. The venue is closed Sunday through Tuesday. For live music schedules and special events check the venues website or social media.

title: Knuckleheads
venue_description:
About Knuckleheads

Knuckleheads has established itself as one of Kansas Citys premier live music destinations earning the tagline Where the worlds greatest musicians play. Located at 2715 Rochester Avenue this legendary venue features multiple performance spaces including an indoor stage with a 600-person capacity and an outdoor garage area perfect for larger shows and festivals.

Open Jam Sessions

Knuckleheads hosts free open jam sessions on both Saturday and Sunday afternoons providing a platform for local musicians to showcase their talents. Saturday sessions run from 12:30 PM to 6 PM and are hosted by Duane Goldston and Billy Ebeling. Sunday sessions run from 1 PM to approximately 6 PM and are hosted by the Kansas City blues band Levee Town. These jams feature a diverse mix of musical styles including zydeco blues oldies classic rock and country. Musicians of all skill levels are welcome to sign up and perform. While the venue is 21+ minors are permitted when accompanied by a parent or guardian. Performers can bring their own microphones or use sanitized house equipment. Saturday afternoons also feature $1 tacos making it an affordable and enjoyable experience for both performers and audience members.

Regular Concert Schedule

Beyond the weekend jams Knuckleheads operates as a full-time concert venue Wednesday through Monday with shows typically starting between 7:30-8 PM. The venue books an impressive range of national touring acts and local favorites across multiple genres including blues rock country Americana folk and roots music. Past performers have included Robert Cray Yonder Mountain String Band and countless other acclaimed artists. The venue regularly sells out shows demonstrating its popularity among music fans.

Special Events

In addition to concerts and jams Knuckleheads hosts unique events such as The Moth Open Mic Storytelling Competition tribute band performances and themed music nights. The venue participates in regional blues competitions including the IBC Road to Memphis Finals.

Venue Atmosphere

Knuckleheads embodies the spirit of an authentic music club with its eclectic decor vintage motorcycles and memorabilia creating a distinctly Kansas City vibe. The indoor saloon features a long bar comfortable seating and excellent sightlines to the stage. The outdoor garage space provides a unique setting for summer concerts and festivals. The venues sound system and stage equipment are top-notch ensuring quality performances for both artists and audiences.

Food and Drink

The venue offers full bar service with reasonably priced drinks and a selection of beer wine and cocktails. Food options include bar favorites and weekend specials like the popular $1 tacos on Saturday afternoons.

Hours and Accessibility

Knuckleheads is open Wednesday and Thursday from 7-11 PM Friday from 7 PM to midnight Saturday from noon-5 PM and 7 PM to midnight and Sunday from noon-6 PM with occasional events on Monday and Tuesday. Free street parking is available in the surrounding area. The venue is accessible and welcoming to music lovers of all ages with appropriate guardian supervision for minors.

title: BB's Lawnside BBQ
venue_description:
About BBs Lawnside BBQ

BBs Lawnside BBQ has been Kansas Citys premier destination where BBQ meets the Blues for over three decades. Located at 1205 E 85th Street in south Kansas City this authentic dive venue combines award-winning slow-smoked barbecue with live blues music six nights a week creating a uniquely Kansas City experience that has attracted locals and tourists alike since the early 1990s.

Historic BBQ and Blues Tradition

The tradition of pairing barbecue with blues in Kansas City dates back to the 1930s when legends like Count Basie Joe Turner and Charlie Parker frequented the Old Kentucky Bar-B-Q near the historic 18th and Vine jazz district. BBs Lawnside continues this storied legacy in remarkable fashion. The venues BBQ pit built in 1950 uses granite stones salvaged from downtown Kansas City crosswalks - the same stones that jazz greats like Joe Turner may have walked across. These granite stones retain heat perfectly allowing for the slow indirect smoking process that defines authentic Kansas City barbecue.

Award-Winning Barbecue

The food at BBs is overseen by Mike Nickle a Certified Kansas City Barbecue Society judge and Grand Champion BBQ Pit Master who has been perfecting the craft for 30 years. Nickle and his team Nickleboysbbq have won countless KCBS awards competing alongside his parents Jim and Connie. Briskets are smoked 14-16 hours and ribs 10-12 hours using hickory wood and indirect heat. The menu features Kansas City classics including meaty pork spare ribs burnt ends sliced beef turkey ham and pulled pork. Louisiana influences appear in dishes like Smokey Jos Gumbo Dirty Reds Jambalaya Red Beans and Rice and Cajun Crawfish Tails reflecting co-owner Jo Shannons Louisiana heritage. The famous BBQ Sundae layers pit beans coleslaw and pulled pork in a Mason jar. BBs has been featured on Food Networks Diners Drive-Ins and Dives.

Live Blues Music

BBs features live blues music Wednesday through Sunday with some of Kansas Citys finest blues musicians and bands. The House Rockers serve as the venues legendary house band backing various performers throughout the week. Mama Ray leads the iconic Saturday afternoon blues jam from 2-6 PM which has become one of Kansas Citys greatest and longest-running jam traditions. You never know which local blues legends might stop by to sit in with Mama Ray. Wednesday nights feature Jaisson Taylor and Brandon Hudspeth with their special brand of blues. Thursday is jam night. Friday through Sunday evenings showcase various local and touring blues acts. The venue also hosts monthly Kansas City Blues Society jam sessions and benefits including the Acoustic Blues Showcase and Hope House benefit. The intimate space features murals and posters dedicated to blues legends creating an authentic juke joint atmosphere.

Atmosphere and Vibe

BBs is unapologetically a dive bar in the best sense of the word. The interior is decorated with hand-painted murals of blues greats vintage posters and memorabilia celebrating the blues tradition. Seating includes indoor tables and picnic tables on the outdoor patio where you can enjoy food and music under the stars. The crowd is diverse and welcoming ranging from blues aficionados to families to tourists seeking an authentic Kansas City experience. Service is friendly and unpretentious. The venue encourages guests to feel the music throw their heads back and embrace the spirit of the blues. As longtime owner Lindsay Shannon used to say on his radio show Just sit back pop the top on a cool one pull up a chair and enjoy some great blues and BBQ.

Ownership and Community

Founded by Lindsay and Jo Shannon BBs was taken over by the Nickle family in June 2022. The Nickles have deep roots at BBs with Mike Nickle working there for 30 years after starting part-time in high school. The family has maintained the Shannons vision while bringing their championship BBQ expertise to the kitchen. Lindsay Shannon a founding member of the Kansas City Blues Society in 1980 and former blues radio DJ on 101.1 The Fox was honored with the Blues Foundations Keeping the Blues Alive award in 1992. The venue remains committed to supporting the Kansas City blues community.

Hours and Details

BBs Lawnside BBQ is open Tuesday through Saturday from 11 AM to 9-10 PM and Sunday from 11 AM to 8 PM. Closed Mondays. Live music typically starts around 7-8 PM on performance nights with the Saturday jam beginning at 2 PM. The venue accepts walk-ins only with no reservations. Full bar service is available with reasonably priced drinks. Ample parking is available.

title: The Rino
venue_description:
About The Rino

The Rino serves as a dynamic music venue and event space in the heart of the River North District in North Kansas City. The name Rino is short for River North perfectly capturing the venues location in one of Kansas Citys coolest and fastest-growing neighborhoods just north of the Missouri River.

Song Lab Music Open Mic

Every Monday night The Rino hosts Song Lab a free music open mic from 7-10 PM. This weekly event welcomes musicians of all skill levels and genres providing a supportive environment for performers to share original music covers and work in progress. The venue provides a professional PA system stage and sound equipment ensuring quality performances. Theres no cover charge to perform or attend making it an accessible opportunity for emerging artists and music fans alike.

Venue Space and Capabilities

The Rino is a 200-person capacity venue featuring excellent acoustics a proper stage and professional A/V equipment. The space is designed specifically for live music with careful attention to sound quality and performer needs. The venue is passionate about supporting local music and touring artists with a unique business model where 100% of all cover charges go directly to the bands and promoters. Shows can be held Thursday through Monday nights while Tuesdays are reserved for the music open mic.

Day-Time Co-Working Space

In an innovative dual-use model The Rino operates as a free co-working space during daytime hours opening at 7 AM. Working alongside nextdoor neighbor Cultivar the venue provides workspace for freelancers remote workers and creatives. Patrons can grab morning beverages from Post Coffees menu featuring locally-roasted coffee drinks and NKC-based Lucky Elixir kombucha.

Location and Neighborhood

Located at 314 Armour Road in North Kansas City The Rino sits in the vibrant River North district also known as Northtown. The neighborhood is experiencing rapid growth with new restaurants cafes breweries and cultural spaces opening regularly. Its just a short bridge from the City Market area making it easily accessible from downtown Kansas City. The surrounding area offers a walkable mix of dining shopping and entertainment options.

Community Focus

The Rino positions itself as more than just a music venue - its a community space dedicated to supporting local artists and fostering creative collaboration. The combination of daytime co-working and nighttime performances creates opportunities for networking and artistic development. The venues commitment to giving all door proceeds to performers demonstrates genuine support for the local music ecosystem.

Bar and Amenities

Full bar service is available during evening events with friendly and personable bartenders. The venue maintains a welcoming atmosphere whether guests come to perform enjoy live music or simply hang out with friends.
location: 314 Armour Rd North Kansas City MO 64116

title: Green Lady Lounge
venue_description:
About Green Lady Lounge

Green Lady Lounge stands as Kansas Citys premier exclusively-jazz venue honoring and advancing the citys legendary jazz heritage. Located at 1809 Grand Boulevard in the historic Crossroads Arts District this intimate two-level lounge has become an essential destination for jazz enthusiasts and a vital performance space for Kansas City jazz musicians.

Kansas City Jazz Heritage

Kansas City has a rich and real jazz history as one of the birthplaces of American jazz in the 1920s and 1930s. Legends like Count Basie Charlie Parker and Jay McShann developed the Kansas City Sound here characterized by blues-based improvisation and swing rhythms. Green Lady Lounge proudly continues this tradition recognizing that Kansas City jazz is not just history but alive thriving and still growing today. The sheer number of amazingly talented jazz musicians in Kansas City is beyond comparison especially for a city of this size.

Live Jazz Every Night

Green Lady Lounge features live Kansas City jazz musicians 365 days a year seven nights a week with never a cover charge. Performances run Sunday through Friday from 5 PM to 3 AM and Saturday from 2 PM to 3 AM providing late-night jazz for night owls and weekend afternoon sessions for early birds. The lounge features two stages on two levels allowing simultaneous performances upstairs and in the basement. Musicians perform only original Kansas City jazz compositions creating a unique sound you wont hear anywhere else. The performance calendar includes some of the worlds best jazz musicians both local legends and visiting artists.

Atmosphere and Ambiance

The venue embodies a speakeasy aesthetic with rich red walls vintage oil paintings crystal chandeliers and plush seating arrangements. Free of televisions guests can focus entirely on the music atmosphere and conversation. The downstairs basement lounge offers an especially intimate setting with seating close to the musicians. The upstairs level provides additional space with its own stage and vibe. Seating is first-come first-served and the venue maintains a cozy sophisticated ambiance even when packed.

House Equipment

Green Lady Lounge maintains impressive house equipment including two Hammond organs three Leslie speakers one baby grand piano and professional sound systems on both levels. This high-quality gear supports the musicians and ensures excellent sound quality throughout the venue.

Food Drinks and Pricing

While Green Lady Lounge does not serve full meals they offer appetizers including a popular cheesecake. The bar serves craft cocktails classic drinks beer and wine at reasonable prices. Signature drinks include the Old Fashioned Manhattan Pink Lady Kansas City Coffee and various martinis. There is typically a modest cover charge of $5-10 at the door accepting both cash and credit. Given the quality of music and atmosphere this represents exceptional value.

Radio Broadcasts

Kansas Public Radio broadcasts live performances from Green Lady Lounge every Saturday at 6 PM and Sunday at 9 PM as encore presentations on the program Live at Green Lady Lounge hosted by Kansas City jazz artist David Basse. The program also features recordings from owner John Scotts other venues The Black Dolphin and the Orion Room giving listeners across Kansas a front-row seat to the music being created in Kansas City today.

Ownership and Philosophy

Green Lady Lounge along with sister venues The Black Dolphin and Orion Room is owned by John Scott a dedicated supporter of Kansas City jazz. The venues philosophy centers on featuring Kansas City jazz musicians performing original compositions in the rich Kansas City tradition. The respectfully attired but unpretentious staff create a welcoming environment for jazz lovers of all backgrounds.

Location and Accessibility

Located in the Crossroads Arts District near 18th Street and Grand Boulevard Green Lady Lounge sits in the heart of Kansas Citys cultural renaissance. The area features numerous art galleries restaurants and cultural attractions making it perfect for a full evening out. Street parking is available in the surrounding area. The venue is 21+ only. The signage can be subtle so first-time visitors should look carefully for the entrance.

title: The Brick
venue_description:
About The Brick

The Brick is a beloved Kansas City institution combining the charm of an old-school dive bar with quality live music and surprisingly good comfort food. Located at 1727 McGee in the downtown Crossroads Arts District this small intimate venue has been featured on Food Networks Diners Drive-Ins and Dives and earned a loyal following for its Monday meatloaf special and eclectic entertainment.

Live Music and Open Mics

The Brick hosts a variety of musical performances throughout the week with a particular emphasis on bluegrass and roots music. The venue is known for its bluegrass open mic nights which draw both seasoned players and newcomers in a friendly welcoming atmosphere. The small stage and intimate setting create an up-close experience where the audience feels connected to the performers. General admission is mostly standing room with limited seating available on a first-come basis.

Food and Drink

While The Brick is definitely a bar first the food has earned significant acclaim. The Monday night special featuring meatloaf dinner with side salad and chocolate cake for under $10 has become legendary among regulars. The meal is described as home cooking - simple delicious and filling. Other menu items include bar food baskets and comfort food classics. The beer selection is solid with right-priced drinks and a no-frills approach that fits the dive bar aesthetic.

Atmosphere and Character

The Brick embraces its dive bar identity with shabby-chic charm. One wall features exposed brick covered with hand-written messages from patrons over the years. Walls are decorated with random prints posters and memorabilia creating an eclectic collage of Kansas City music and culture history. The space is small and can feel cramped when crowded but this intimacy is part of the venues appeal. The crowd is mixed and welcoming drawing everyone from downtown professionals to artists to music lovers.

Hours and Operation

The Brick is open from noon to 3 AM daily making it a destination for both daytime hangs and late-night sessions. There is no advance box office - tickets when required are available at the door when the club opens for shows. Will call is available once doors open.

Location

Situated in the Crossroads Arts District The Brick is surrounded by galleries restaurants and cultural venues making it part of Kansas Citys vibrant downtown arts scene. The area comes alive during First Friday art walks and weekend evenings.

title: RecordBar
venue_description:
About RecordBar

RecordBar has established itself as Kansas Citys premier venue for indie rock alternative and emerging artists. Located at 1520 Grand Boulevard in the Crossroads Arts District this intimate 18+ venue offers an exceptional live music experience with top-notch sound quality and a commitment to showcasing both local and touring talent.

Music Programming

RecordBar books an impressive and diverse lineup spanning indie rock alternative punk folk Americana and beyond. The venue regularly hosts nationally touring acts as well as the best of Kansas Citys local music scene. Shows typically have an 18+ age requirement creating an atmosphere that welcomes young adults while maintaining a mature concert environment. Doors usually open around 7 PM with music starting shortly after. The venues booking philosophy emphasizes quality over genre helping music fans discover new artists they might not encounter elsewhere.

Venue Space and Sound

The venue features a stylish interior with excellent acoustics and a professional sound system that does justice to every performance. The general admission standing room layout creates an intimate connection between artists and audience with good sightlines throughout the space. The stage setup and lighting are professional-grade ensuring both performers and attendees have a top-quality experience.

Community Events

Beyond regular concerts RecordBar prides itself on fostering community through special events. The venue hosts open mic nights album release parties and themed music nights providing platforms for emerging artists to showcase their talents and for music lovers to connect over shared passion. These events create a sense of community and support for the local music ecosystem.

Bar and Atmosphere

RecordBar maintains a full bar with friendly knowledgeable bartenders ready to craft your favorite drink or recommend something new. The drink menu includes craft cocktails local beers and a solid wine selection. The venues atmosphere balances the energy of a rock club with the sophistication of the Crossroads Arts District. The space feels both intimate and energetic perfect for losing yourself in the music.

Location

Situated in the heart of the Crossroads Arts District RecordBar is easily accessible and surrounded by a vibrant cultural scene. The area features numerous art galleries restaurants coffee shops and entertainment venues making it an ideal destination for a full night out. Convenient and affordable parking can be reserved in advance through SpotHero.

Supporting Artists

RecordBar is known for its artist-friendly approach fairly compensating performers and providing professional working conditions. This commitment has made it a favorite stop for touring bands and a launching pad for local acts.
